# Sprint or increment review — meeting archetype

## When this lens applies

Apply this lens when the team inspects a completed increment with stakeholders,
demonstrates outcomes, gathers feedback, and discusses what to adapt next.

## What to extract

- Capture demonstrated outcomes and the evidence or reaction attached to them.
- Separate accepted feedback, new ideas, and agreed follow-up work.
- Record changed priorities, assumptions, or backlog direction with their rationale.
- Name owners only when the meeting assigned them.

## Missing topics worth noting

Note feedback with no disposition and agreed changes with no route into future
work. Do not require every review to be a formal product demo.

## Common interpretation mistakes

Do not treat stakeholder interest as acceptance, every suggestion as backlog
scope, or the review as a team-performance evaluation.
